previous_statement: Uniform complete norm estimate. After decreasing the universal smallness ceiling, the same assembled maps satisfy (1-K_norm e)||X|| <= ||gamma_n(X)|| <= (1+K_norm e)||X|| for every n and X, for one universal K_norm; hence gamma is an extended K_norm e-inclusion once the homomorphism estimate is included.
new_statement: Uniform complete norm estimate. There exist universal constants K_norm < infinity and e_norm > 0 such that, whenever e:=rho+epsilon <= e_norm, the same assembled maps satisfy (1-K_norm e)||X|| <= ||gamma_n(X)|| <= (1+K_norm e)||X|| for every n >= 1 and every X in M_n tensor B.
